historical_claims.anchor: Kafka wrote most of The Trial in 1914 and 1915.
His friend Max Brod disregarded instructions to destroy unpublished papers and issued the novel in 1925.
Modern scholarly editions have revisited the manuscript material and the editorial decisions behind the familiar text.
The common English title, The Trial, draws attention to a judicial event.

work.note: The existing survey and claim 032000-c02 date posthumous publication to 1925. Composition in 1914–1915 is a separate fact, not the selected sort date.
